items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: And then two piano players at the Cosmopolitan Club, Tony Jackson and myself in Louisville.

ctx.x: Did they just use a piano? They didn't have a band? No, just a piano. Just a piano?
Just a piano around all the pleasure houses. And then two piano players at the Cosmopolitan Club, Tony Jackson and myself in Louisville.
That's where you first met Tony?
